_readme: Application (app-only) permissions considered highly privileged for this audit, grouped by resource appId. Critical is reserved for a direct or 1-2 hop path to tenant takeover; service-specific or data-plane permissions that need additional prerequisites are High. 'severity' is either 'Critical' or 'High'. Edit freely: add/remove roles or whole resources. Matching is done by permission value against each resource's appRoles, so entries here are tenant-agnostic and safe to reuse across environments.

checks._readme: Check-run configuration for the attack-surface audit. 'enabled' toggles individual checks (empty = all on), 'min_severity' drops findings below a level (Critical/High/Medium/Low/Info), 'suppress' silences findings by 'check_id:primary_object_id' (or just 'check_id' to drop a whole check).

directory_roles._readme: Directory role displayName -> severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low/Info) for the privileged-users check. Critical is reserved for a direct or 1-2 hop path to tenant takeover; broader administrative roles are High. Roles not listed here (or custom roles) render as Info until you rate them. Add/modify freely per tenant. Optional drawer descriptions live in directory_role_descriptions below.

directory_role_descriptions._readme: Optional directory role displayName -> description shown in the SP/app drawer's Assigned roles section. Roles without an entry show no description. '_'-prefixed keys are comments.
directory_role_descriptions.Global Administrator: Full control of all tenant settings, users, and administrative features.
directory_role_descriptions.Privileged Role Administrator: Can assign and manage all directory roles, including Global Administrator.
directory_role_descriptions.Privileged Authentication Administrator: Can reset passwords and authentication methods for any user, including Global Administrators.
directory_role_descriptions.Application Administrator: Manages all app registrations, enterprise apps, and app credentials, including App Proxy.
directory_role_descriptions.Groups Administrator: Manages all groups and group membership, except role-assignable groups.
directory_role_descriptions.Cloud Application Administrator: Manages app registrations and enterprise apps, except App Proxy.
directory_role_descriptions.Hybrid Identity Administrator: Manages Entra Connect, PHS/PTA, seamless SSO, and federation settings.
directory_role_descriptions.Tenant Governance Administrator: Manages Tenant Governance relationships, policy templates, and delegated administration.
directory_role_descriptions.Conditional Access Administrator: Creates and manages Conditional Access policies.
directory_role_descriptions.Security Administrator: Manages security policies, alerts, and reports across Microsoft 365.
directory_role_descriptions.Security Operator: Investigates and responds to security incidents and performs identity containment actions.
directory_role_descriptions.Exchange Administrator: Manages Exchange Online mail flow, mailboxes, and policies.
directory_role_descriptions.Intune Administrator: Manages Intune device configuration, compliance, apps, and policies.
directory_role_descriptions.SharePoint Administrator: Manages SharePoint Online sites, settings, and policies.
directory_role_descriptions.Teams Administrator: Manages Teams settings, meetings, messaging, and voice policies.
directory_role_descriptions.User Administrator: Manages users, groups, and passwords for limited administrators.
directory_role_descriptions.Authentication Administrator: Manages authentication methods and resets passwords for non-admin users.
directory_role_descriptions.Helpdesk Administrator: Resets passwords and manages service requests for non-admin users.
directory_role_descriptions.Password Administrator: Resets passwords for non-admin users and Password Administrators.
directory_role_descriptions.Agent ID Administrator: Manages agent identities, blueprints, credentials, and lifecycle.
directory_role_descriptions.Directory Readers: Can read directory objects and basic tenant settings.
directory_role_descriptions.Global Reader: Read-only access to all tenant configuration and data.
directory_role_descriptions.Application Developer: Can create app registrations and manage apps they own.
directory_role_descriptions.Billing Administrator: Manages billing, subscriptions, and purchase-related tasks.
directory_role_descriptions.Message Center Reader: Reads Microsoft 365 Message Center posts and service health.
directory_role_descriptions.Reports Reader: Reads usage reports and adoption data.
directory_role_descriptions.Knowledge Administrator: Manages knowledge and Viva Topics settings.
directory_role_descriptions.Search Administrator: Manages Microsoft Search settings and content.
directory_role_descriptions.Service Support Administrator: Reads service health and manages support tickets.
directory_role_descriptions.Usage Summary Reports Reader: Reads usage summary reports without user details.
directory_role_descriptions.Yammer Administrator: Manages Yammer/Viva Engage settings and policies.
directory_role_descriptions.Viva Engage Administrator: Manages Viva Engage settings and policies.
directory_role_descriptions.Partner Tier2 Support: Deprecated partner support role; can reset passwords and revoke tokens for all admins, including Global Administrators.

role_labels._readme: Permission value -> drawer description. These entries override the description captured from the directory/app catalog. Add or override entries here per tenant. '_'-prefixed keys are comments.
role_labels.AppRoleAssignment.ReadWrite.All: Read and write all app role assignments
role_labels.RoleAssignmentSchedule.ReadWrite.Directo: Read and write the role assignment schedule (PIM)
role_labels.User.ReadWrite.All: Read and write all users' full profiles
role_labels.Group.ReadWrite.All: Read and write all groups except role-assignable
role_labels.GroupMember.ReadWrite.All: Read and write all group memberships except role-assignable
role_labels.UserAuthenticationMethod.ReadWrite.All: Read and write user authentication methods except for privileged users
role_labels.PrivilegedAccess.ReadWrite.AzureAD: Manage PIM assignments for Azure AD roles
role_labels.PrivilegedAccess.ReadWrite.AzureADGroup: Manage PIM assignments for privileged groups
role_labels.Sites.FullControl.All: Full control on all site collections
role_labels.Sites.ReadWrite.All: Read and write all site collections
role_labels.Chat.ReadWrite.All: Read and write all chat messages
role_labels.Exchange.AdminAPI.ManageAsApp: Full control of Exchange Online via the admin API

roles.reason: Assign any Entra directory role to any principal. Direct path to Global Administrator.
Grant any Graph app role to any service principal without an admin-approval workflow. Chain: grant self RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory, then assign Global Administrator.
Add credentials to any app or SP and modify app properties — hijack high-privilege apps. A standard tenant-takeover primitive.
Create and configure federated domains. Combined with Hybrid Identity Administrator this enables Golden SAML without on-prem ADFS.
Assign the Global Administrator role to a controlled user account by creating an active PIM role assignment.
Add authentication methods, such as a Temporary Access Pass, to any non-privileged user - direct account takeover when granted as an app role.
Read and write directory data, including setting group memberships. Cannot directly manage role assignments or add users to role-assignable groups.
Modify user properties, managers, and profile data. Does not include password reset.
Add/remove members from any security group; add self to groups with ARM RBAC assignments. Cannot modify role-assignable groups — those require RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory.
Create or modify Conditional Access policies: disable MFA for specific users or apps and create exclusions for the attacker identity.
Push Intune device configuration/compliance policies fleet-wide. Combined with DeviceManagementScripts.ReadWrite.All: code execution on managed workstations and PAWs.
Deploy scripts to Intune-managed devices. Combined with DeviceManagementConfiguration.ReadWrite.All: fleet-wide code execution on managed workstations and PAWs.
Can add members to any group except for role-assignable groups.
Can manage directory synchronization jobs/credentials used for identity provisioning. Requires an existing sync topology and additional steps for tenant-wide control.
Can manage PIM eligible/active role assignments for Azure AD roles.
Can manage PIM eligible/active assignments for privileged access groups.
Broader variant of directory role management read/write across Microsoft 365 services.
Can push apps/scripts and issue remote actions to all Intune-managed devices — fleet-wide code execution, but not a direct tenant takeover path.
Can manage Intune role-based access control assignments.
Can send mail as any user in the organization — commonly abused for BEC/phishing.
Can read and write mail in any mailbox in the organization.
Can modify any mailbox's settings, including inbox rules and forwarding — common exfiltration technique.
Can read/write all files across OneDrive and SharePoint.
Full control over all SharePoint site collections. Data-plane access; not a direct tenant takeover path.
Read/write access to all SharePoint site collections.
Can read and write all Teams chat messages across the organization.

Current-generation equivalent of Exchange.ManageAsApp. Requires Exchange admin privileges; not a direct tenant takeover path.
